name: M1A2 Abrams (SEPv3)
note: General Dynamics Land Systems M1A2 Abrams main battle tank (current US build is the SEPv3). Crew of 4. Main gun is the 120 mm M256 smoothbore; no gun-launched ATGM. Weight ~69.5 t. Road cruising range ~426 km. Gun direct-fire range is an estimate (not published).
